articles.detail: 5 cycles, all 5 completed, avg 9 published/cycle — down from yesterday's 69

experiment: Skipped. No experiment was active to evaluate, no pause gate is set, and every goal metric cleared its target — skip-if-healthy applies. The one queued candidate (2026-05-08-numerical-density) edits scripts/write-prompt.md, which is outside the parameter set this audit may touch, so it stays queued.
weakestArea: Freshness, in the sense that it is the only metric that moved materially the wrong way: median 0.2 → 0.7 and p90 0.8 → 1.5, still inside the ≤1.0 median target but with the whole distribution shifted about half a day older. The caveat is the same one this file has carried all week and it bites harder today — freshness is computed over 12 of 51 articles, a 24% sample, so a single cycle of older standalone picks moves the median. Nothing here justifies touching the standalone cap, which experiment 2026-04-26-standalone-cap-22 already tuned for exactly this; one day inside target is drift, not a signal.
watching: The Gaza withdrawal clause still names no verifier, and today's Sheikh Radwan drone strike and the Lebanon demolitions both test the same unmonitored ceasefire from two directions.
Interceptor depth is now a stated constraint in two places at once — EUCOM's magazine warning and the Kyiv barrage's civilian toll; the supply-side story is becoming the story.
Iran's founding of WAICO gives the AI-standards split a formal bloc with a charter, which is a durable institutional peg rather than a one-day filing.

Two consecutive cold-wallet sweeps ($70M then $89M) plus generative fraud erasing stylistic tells suggest one campaign, not three incidents; the ledger-versus-agency framing should hold across the next wave.
The CPC storage fill and drone strikes on the Kazakh export route make a single-point failure legible in the chokepoint layer, which currently has no mark for it.
Venezuela's transition talks exclude Machado, so the legitimacy question is being decided before the negotiation is, and that is what will need re-reporting.
coverageGaps: Oceania filed nothing at all today — region count fell 6 → 5 and neither Australia nor the Pacific island states appear.
Europe and Africa sit at 5 datelines each against the Americas' 18 and the Middle East's 16; the board is genuinely two-region-heavy today.

South Asia is heavily India-weighted through Hindustan Times, NDTV, India.com, India Today, Firstpost, News18, Times of India and mint — eight Indian outlets, no single one dominant, but the country's share of the source base is well ahead of its share of stories.
Central Asia and the Caucasus produce only the CPC route and a single APA filing — the sixth day with almost nothing between Ankara and Delhi.
Economy is the smallest category at 10 and is carried by Saudi, Egypt, South Africa and India; no European or East Asian macro filing appeared.
context: A lighter day than yesterday — 51 articles against 69 — but with all five cycles completing rather than four, so the drop is per-cycle yield (9 vs the prior day's higher count) rather than a failed run. Quality of spread held: 46 unique sources, zero duplicates, top source at 12%, multi-source at 12, sci+tech at 41% for the second straight day. Cycle timing is stable at 1078s (selector 351s, writer 247s, editor 75s); the low-effort Sonnet-5 editor remains a non-factor in wall-time. The only real movement is freshness aging half a day and Oceania dropping out, and neither breaches a target. No experiment has been active since 2026-05-18. TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 — each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle against a capped spend.
